name: Custom Board Comments
description: Adds likes, best comments, and sorting to official board comments.

ui.login_to_like: Sign in to like a comment.

settings.title: Board comment extras
settings.description: Show likes, best comments, and sorting on post pages without editing the theme.
settings.notice: Refresh a post page after saving. The sirsoft-board module must be active.

enabled.label: Enable comment extras
enabled.hint: Shows likes, best comments, and sorting on post comment sections.

allow_guest_likes.label: Allow guest likes
allow_guest_likes.hint: When off, only signed-in members can like. Guests are limited to one like per IP.

stickers_enabled.label: Sticker insert
stickers_enabled.hint: Lets visitors insert stickers into the comment box.

sticker_pack.label: Sticker pack
sticker_pack.hint: Simple is a short set. The large set has 700+ stickers.

stickers_animated.label: Animated stickers
stickers_animated.hint: Stickers bounce and wiggle with CSS. Turn off for still emoji. No remote GIF files.

images_enabled.label: Image insert
images_enabled.hint: Signed-in members can attach images to comments. 2MB max.

default_sort.label: Default sort
default_sort.hint: The first comment order visitors see.

board_slugs.label: Board slugs
board_slugs.hint: Defaults to the free board. Comma-separated; leave empty to apply to every board.

best_enabled.label: Enable best comments
best_enabled.hint: Pins comments at or above the like threshold and shows a badge.

best_threshold.label: Best-comment like threshold
best_threshold.hint: Only comments with at least this many likes become best comments.

best_limit.label: Maximum best comments
best_limit.hint: How many best comments to pin at the top.
